code.description:
(Optional) **Required.** Shell command to execute in bash (NOT a Python interpreter). Commands run in the sandbox root directory (/filesystem) with a default timeout of 300 seconds. Certain paths (/app, /.apps_data) are blocked for security. Examples: (1) Simple Python one-liner: `python -c 'print(1+1)'` (2) Multi-line Python script: `cat > script.py << 'EOF'
import pandas
print(pandas.__version__)
EOF && python script.py` (3) Shell commands: `ls -la`, `echo hello`, `pip install requests` (4) File operations: `mkdir mydir && touch mydir/file.txt`. Pass an empty string to execute a no-op shell command.

path.description: (Optional) Absolute path within the sandbox filesystem to list. Must start with '/'. This is NOT a system path - '/' refers to the sandbox root. Default: '/' (sandbox root). Example: '/documents' or '/data/uploads'. Returns a newline-separated string where each line describes one entry: "'name' (folder)\n" for directories, "'name' (mime/type file) N bytes\n" for files. MIME type is guessed from extension ('unknown' if undetectable). Returns '[not found: path]', '[permission denied: path]', or '[not a directory: path]' for errors. Returns 'No items found' for empty directories.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the image file within the sandbox filesystem. REQUIRED. Must start with '/'. Supported formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, GIF, WEBP (case-insensitive). Example: '/images/screenshot.png' or '/uploads/photo.jpg'. Returns an Image object with 'data' (binary image content) and 'format' (string: 'png', 'jpeg', 'gif', or 'webp'). Raises FileNotFoundError if file doesn't exist, ValueError for unsupported formats or non-file paths, RuntimeError for read failures.

Absolute path to the text file within the sandbox filesystem. REQUIRED. Must start with '/'. Supported extensions: txt, json, csv, py, md, xml, yaml, yml, js, ts, jsx, tsx, htm, html, css, scss, less, java, c, cpp, h, hpp, rs, go, rb, php, sh, bash, zsh, fish, ps1, bat, cmd, sql, graphql, gql, toml, ini, cfg, conf, env, properties, log, gitignore, dockerignore, editorconfig, rst, tex, bib. Also supports extensionless files: Makefile, Dockerfile, Vagrantfile. Example: '/config/settings.json' or '/src/main.py'. Returns the complete text content of the file as a string. Raises FileNotFoundError if file doesn't exist, ValueError for unsupported extensions or encoding errors, RuntimeError for other read failures. Note: Very large files (>3GB) will succeed but may be slow and memory-intensive.

encoding.description: (Optional) Character encoding for reading the file. Default: 'utf-8'. Common values: 'utf-8', 'latin-1', 'ascii', 'utf-16', 'cp1252'. Raises ValueError if the file cannot be decoded with the specified encoding.

max_size.description: (Optional) DEPRECATED - This parameter is ignored and has no effect. Included only for backward compatibility. Files of any size can be read; a warning is logged for files exceeding 3GB.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match filenames (not full paths). Uses shell-style wildcards: '*' matches any characters, '?' matches single character, '[seq]' matches any character in seq. Does NOT support '**' for recursive directory matching (use 'recursive' parameter instead). Examples: '*.json' (all JSON files), 'report_*.csv' (CSV files starting with 'report_'), 'data_?.txt' (data_1.txt, data_a.txt, etc.). Returns a string with format: 'Found N file(s) matching 'pattern':\n' followed by newline-separated absolute paths within the sandbox. If no matches: 'No files matching 'pattern' found in path'. Error cases return bracketed messages: '[not found: path]', '[access denied: path]', '[not a directory: path]', '[permission denied: path]'.

path.description: (Optional) Directory path within the sandbox to search in. Must start with '/'. Default: '/' (sandbox root). Example: '/documents' or '/data/exports'

recursive.description: (Optional) Search recursively through all subdirectories. Default: true. Note: Symlinks pointing outside the sandbox are skipped for security.

max_results.description: (Optional) Maximum number of matching files to return. Default: 100. Set to 0 for unlimited results. When the limit is reached, results are truncated and a '(Results limited to N)' message is appended.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file or directory within the sandbox filesystem. REQUIRED. Must start with '/'. The path is relative to the sandbox root, not the host system. Example: '/documents/report.pdf' or '/data/config.json'. Returns a newline-separated string containing: Path, Type (file/directory/symlink), MIME type (for files), Size (in bytes and human-readable), Permissions (rwx format and octal), Modified/Accessed/Created timestamps (ISO 8601), Inode, Device, Hard links count. Returns '[not found: path]' if path doesn't exist, '[access denied: path]' if outside sandbox, '[permission denied: path]' for permission errors.

path.description: (Optional) Directory path within the sandbox to display as a tree. Must start with '/'. Default: '/' (sandbox root). Example: '/documents' or '/project/src'. Returns an ASCII tree representation using box-drawing characters. Format: root path on first line, then indented entries with connectors ('+-- ' for last items, '|-- ' for others). Directories end with '/'. Files show '(N bytes)' suffix when show_size is true. Returns '[not found: path]', '[access denied: path]', '[not a directory: path]' for errors, or '(empty)' for empty directories.

max_depth.description: (Optional) Maximum directory depth to traverse, where 1 shows only immediate children. Range: 1-10 (values outside this range are clamped). Default: 3. Higher values show more nested structure but take longer.

include_files.description: (Optional) Include files in the tree output. Default: true. When false, only directories are shown. Directories are always included regardless of this setting.

show_size.description: (Optional) Show file sizes in bytes next to each file. Default: false. Format: 'filename (N bytes)'. Only applies when include_files is true.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .csv file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/input.csv')

delimiter.description: (Optional) Column delimiter character. Default is ',' (comma). Use '\t' for tab-delimited files, ';' for semicolon-separated

has_header.description: (Optional) If true (default), treats first row as column headers. If false, all rows are data rows

row_limit.description: (Optional) Maximum number of data rows to return (default 1000 for token efficiency, None for unlimited). Header row does NOT count toward this limit. Examples: has_header=True + row_limit=100 returns 101 rows total (1 header + 100 data). has_header=False + row_limit=100 returns 100 rows total.

compact.description: (Optional) If true, use compact CSV-style output without table formatting. Default is false (table format)

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/report.xlsx')
Absolute path to the .xlsx file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/report.xlsx'). File must exist

tab_name.description: Name for the new worksheet tab (e.g., 'Sheet2', 'Sales Data'). Maximum 31 characters. Cannot contain: \ / ? * [ ]. Must not already exist in workbook

anyOf.description: Sheet data definition for adding data to a worksheet (without name).

headers.description: (Optional) Optional array of column header values. When provided, first row is populated with headers and frozen

rows.description: (Optional) Array of data rows. Each row is an array of cell values. When headers are provided, each row must have same length as headers array

sheet_data.description: (Optional) Optional initial data with 'headers' (list of column names) and 'rows' (list of lists of cell values). If headers are provided, rows must match header length. Headers freeze the first row automatically

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/report.xlsx')

tab_index.description: 0-based index of the worksheet tab to delete (e.g., 0 for first tab). Cannot delete the last remaining tab in a workbook

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/report.xlsx')

operations.description: List of edit operation objects. Each must include a 'type' field specifying the operation: 'set_cell', 'append_rows', 'rename_sheet', 'format_cells', 'merge_cells', 'unmerge_cells', 'set_column_width', 'set_row_height', 'freeze_panes', 'add_named_range', 'delete_named_range', 'add_data_validation', 'add_conditional_formatting', 'set_auto_filter', 'set_number_format', 'add_image'. Operations are applied in order

oneOf.description: Operation to set a specific cell value.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'set_cell'

sheet.description: Name of the worksheet tab to modify (e.g., 'Sheet1', 'Sales Data'). Sheet must exist in the workbook

cell.description: Excel cell reference in A1 notation (e.g., 'A1', 'B5', 'AA100'). Column letters followed by row number, case-insensitive

value.description: Value to set in the cell. Can be string, number, boolean, null, or formula string starting with '=' (e.g., '=SUM(A1:A10)')

oneOf.description: Operation to append one or many rows to a sheet.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'append_rows'

sheet.description: Name of the worksheet tab to append rows to (e.g., 'Sheet1'). Sheet will be created if it does not exist

rows.description: (Optional) 2D array of row data to append. Each inner array is one row (e.g., [['John', 30], ['Jane', 25]]). Row length should match existing header columns if present

oneOf.description: Operation to rename a sheet.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'rename_sheet'

sheet.description: Current name of the worksheet tab to rename (e.g., 'Sheet1'). Must exist in the workbook

new_name.description: New name for the worksheet tab (e.g., 'Sales Report'). Must be non-empty and not already exist in the workbook. Maximum 31 characters

oneOf.description: Operation to format cells (font, colors, alignment, borders).

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'format_cells'

sheet.description: Name of the worksheet tab containing cells to format (e.g., 'Sheet1')

range.description: Cell range to format. Supports: single cell ('A1'), range ('A1:B5'), entire column ('A:A'), entire row ('1:1'), or row range ('1:5')

font_name.description: (Optional) Font family name (e.g., 'Arial', 'Calibri', 'Times New Roman'). Null to keep existing font

font_size.description: (Optional) Font size in points (e.g., 11, 14, 18). Null to keep existing size

font_bold.description: (Optional) Set to true for bold text, false for normal weight, null to keep existing

font_italic.description: (Optional) Set to true for italic text, false for normal, null to keep existing

font_underline.description: (Optional) Set to true for underlined text, false to remove underline, null to keep existing

font_color.description: (Optional) Font color as hex string without '#' prefix (e.g., 'FF0000' for red, '0000FF' for blue). 6 or 8 hex digits (RRGGBB or AARRGGBB)

fill_color.description: (Optional) Cell background color as hex string (e.g., 'FFFF00' for yellow). 6 or 8 hex digits

wrap_text.description: (Optional) Set to true to wrap text within cell, false to disable wrapping, null to keep existing

border_color.description: (Optional) Border color as hex string (e.g., '000000' for black). 6 or 8 hex digits

border_sides.description: (Optional) Array of sides to apply border to. Valid values: 'left', 'right', 'top', 'bottom'. If null, applies to all four sides

oneOf.description: Operation to merge cells.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'merge_cells'

sheet.description: Name of the worksheet tab containing cells to merge (e.g., 'Sheet1')

range.description: Cell range to merge in A1:B1 notation (e.g., 'A1:D1' for horizontal merge, 'A1:A5' for vertical merge). Must include at least 2 cells

oneOf.description: Operation to unmerge cells.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'unmerge_cells'

sheet.description: Name of the worksheet tab containing merged cells to unmerge (e.g., 'Sheet1')

range.description: Cell range to unmerge (e.g., 'A1:D1'). Must match an existing merged region

oneOf.description: Operation to set column width.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'set_column_width'

width.description: Column width in character units (Excel's default unit, approximately 7 pixels per unit). Must be positive and not exceed 255

oneOf.description: Operation to set row height.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'set_row_height'

row.description: 1-based row number to resize (e.g., 1 for first row, 10 for tenth row). Must be at least 1

height.description: Row height in points (1 point = 1/72 inch). Must be positive and not exceed 409

oneOf.description: Operation to freeze panes at a specific cell.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'freeze_panes'

cell.description: (Optional) Cell reference where freeze occurs. Rows above and columns to the left of this cell are frozen (e.g., 'B2' freezes row 1 and column A, 'A2' freezes row 1 only). Set to null to unfreeze all panes

oneOf.description: Operation to add a named range.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'add_named_range'

name.description: Name for the range. Must start with letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, underscores, or dots (e.g., 'SalesData', 'Q1_Revenue', 'data.range'). Cannot be an existing name

sheet.description: Name of the worksheet tab containing the range (e.g., 'Sheet1')

range.description: Cell range to name in A1:B10 notation (e.g., 'A1:B10', 'C5:C100')

oneOf.description: Operation to delete a named range.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'delete_named_range'

name.description: Name of the named range to delete. Must exist in the workbook

oneOf.description: Operation to add data validation to cells.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'add_data_validation'

validation_type.description: Type of validation. Valid values: 'list' (dropdown), 'whole' (whole numbers), 'decimal' (decimal numbers), 'date', 'time', 'textLength', 'custom' (formula-based)

operator.description: (Optional) Comparison operator for whole/decimal/date/time/textLength validations. Valid values: 'between', 'notBetween', 'equal', 'notEqual', 'lessThan', 'lessThanOrEqual', 'greaterThan', 'greaterThanOrEqual'. Not used for 'list' type

formula1.description: (Optional) Primary formula/value. For 'list': comma-separated values or cell range (e.g., 'Yes,No,Maybe' or 'Sheet1!A1:A5'). For numeric: the value to compare or range start for 'between'

formula2.description: (Optional) Secondary formula/value for 'between' and 'notBetween' operators. Specifies the upper bound of the range

allow_blank.description: (Optional) If true (default), empty cells pass validation. If false, cells must contain a value

show_error_message.description: (Optional) If true (default), shows error popup when invalid data is entered

error_title.description: (Optional) Title text for the error popup dialog (e.g., 'Invalid Entry')

error_message.description: (Optional) Message text for the error popup (e.g., 'Please enter a number between 1 and 100')

show_input_message.description: (Optional) If true, shows input hint when cell is selected. Default is false

input_title.description: (Optional) Title text for the input hint popup

input_message.description: (Optional) Message text for the input hint popup

oneOf.description: Operation to add conditional formatting.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'add_conditional_formatting'

range.description: Cell range to apply conditional formatting (e.g., 'A1:A100', 'B2:D10')

rule_type.description: Type of conditional rule. Valid values: 'cellIs' (value comparison), 'colorScale' (gradient), 'dataBar' (bar chart in cell), 'expression' (custom formula), 'top10', 'aboveAverage', 'duplicateValues', 'uniqueValues', 'containsText', 'notContainsText', 'beginsWith', 'endsWith', 'containsBlanks', 'notContainsBlanks'

operator.description: (Optional) Comparison operator for 'cellIs' rule_type. Valid values: 'between', 'notBetween', 'equal', 'notEqual', 'lessThan', 'lessThanOrEqual', 'greaterThan', 'greaterThanOrEqual'

formula.description: (Optional) Value or formula for comparison. For 'cellIs': the value to compare (e.g., '100', '=A1'). For 'expression': a formula that returns TRUE/FALSE. For 'between': the lower bound

formula2.description: (Optional) Upper bound value for 'between' and 'notBetween' operators

font_color.description: (Optional) Font color when condition is met, as hex string (e.g., 'FF0000' for red)

fill_color.description: (Optional) Cell background color when condition is met, as hex string (e.g., 'FFFF00' for yellow)

font_bold.description: (Optional) Set to true to make text bold when condition is met

font_italic.description: (Optional) Set to true to make text italic when condition is met

color_scale_colors.description: (Optional) Array of 2 or 3 hex color strings for 'colorScale' rule_type (e.g., ['FF0000', 'FFFF00', '00FF00'] for red-yellow-green gradient)

data_bar_color.description: (Optional) Bar color for 'dataBar' rule_type, as hex string (e.g., '638EC6' for blue)

rank.description: (Optional) Number of top/bottom items for 'top10' rule_type. Default is 10

percent.description: (Optional) If true, 'rank' is treated as percentage for 'top10' rule_type. Default is false

text.description: (Optional) Text to search for in 'containsText', 'notContainsText', 'beginsWith', 'endsWith' rule types

oneOf.description: Operation to set auto-filter on a range.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'set_auto_filter'

range.description: (Optional) Cell range for auto-filter (e.g., 'A1:D10'). Filter dropdowns appear on the first row of the range. Set to null to remove existing auto-filter

oneOf.description: Operation to set number format on cells.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'set_number_format'

format.description: Excel number format string. Examples: '#,##0.00' (thousands separator with 2 decimals), '0%' (percentage), '$#,##0.00' (currency), 'yyyy-mm-dd' (date), '0.00E+00' (scientific). See Excel number format documentation for full syntax

oneOf.description: Operation to add an image to a worksheet.

type.description: Operation type identifier. Must be exactly 'add_image'

image_path.description: Absolute path to the image file (e.g., '/images/logo.png'). Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP

cell.description: Cell reference for top-left corner anchor of the image (e.g., 'A1', 'D5')

width.description: (Optional) Image width in pixels. If null, uses original image width

height.description: (Optional) Image height in pixels. If null, uses original image height

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/report.xlsx')

tab_index.description: 0-based worksheet tab index (e.g., 0 for first tab, 1 for second tab)

cell.description: Excel cell reference (e.g., 'A1', 'B5'). Case-insensitive. The cell must be empty; this tool will not overwrite existing values

value.description: Value to set in the cell. Can be string, number, boolean, or formula starting with '=' (Union of: string, integer, number, boolean)

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/report.xlsx')

tab_index.description: 0-based worksheet tab index (e.g., 0 for first tab, 1 for second tab)

cell.description: Excel cell reference to clear (e.g., 'A1', 'B5'). Case-insensitive. Sets cell value to null/empty

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/report.xlsx')

sheet.description: Name of the worksheet tab containing the source data for the chart (e.g., 'Sheet1', 'Sales Data'). Sheet must exist

data_range.description: Cell range containing chart data in A1:Z99 notation (e.g., 'A1:C10', 'B2:E20'). Must be a bounded rectangular range. First column typically contains category labels, other columns contain data series

chart_type.description: (Optional) Type of chart to create. Valid values: 'bar' (vertical bar/column chart, default), 'line' (line chart), 'pie' (pie chart)

title.description: (Optional) Optional title displayed above the chart (e.g., 'Monthly Sales'). If null, chart type name is used

position.description: (Optional) Cell reference for top-left corner of the chart (e.g., 'E2', 'G5'). Default is 'E2'. Chart is placed in the same sheet as the data

categories_column.description: (Optional) 1-based column index within data_range for category labels (X-axis). Default (null) uses first column as categories. Set to 0 to skip categories entirely. For pie charts, this determines slice labels

include_header.description: (Optional) If true (default), first row of data_range is treated as series names/labels. If false, all rows are data. When true, data_range must contain at least 2 rows

file_path.description: Absolute path to the .xlsx file starting with '/' (e.g., '/data/report.xlsx')

tab_index.description: 0-based worksheet tab index (e.g., 0 for first tab)

filters.description: List of filter condition objects. Each condition has: 'column' (column letter like 'A' or header name if use_headers=true), 'operator' (see valid operators below), 'value' (comparison value, optional for is_empty/is_not_empty). Valid operators: 'equals', 'not_equals', 'greater_than', 'less_than', 'greater_than_or_equal', 'less_than_or_equal', 'contains', 'not_contains', 'starts_with', 'ends_with', 'is_empty', 'is_not_empty'

cell_range.description: (Optional) Optional cell range to filter within (e.g., 'A1:D100', 'B5:F50'). If null, filters entire worksheet. Must be a range (A1:B10), not a single cell

match_all.description: (Optional) If true (default), all filter conditions must match for a row to be included (AND logic). If false, any matching condition includes the row (OR logic)

use_headers.description: (Optional) If true (default), first row is treated as column headers, excluded from filtered results, and column names in filter conditions can reference header values (case-insensitive)

include_diagnostics.description: (Optional) If True, include diagnostic info when no matches found (default False for efficiency)

compact.description: (Optional) Use compact CSV-style output without formatting (default False)
